# Institute for Integrative Psychotherapy

> A professional training institute offering integrative psychotherapy certification, workshops, and continuing education programs grounded in Gestalt, psychodynamic, and transactional analysis approaches.

Founded by Richard Erskine, the Institute for Integrative Psychotherapy provides comprehensive training programs and professional development for psychotherapy practitioners. The institute maintains accreditation with major professional bodies including the National Board of Certified Counselors and the American Psychological Association, with locations in Vancouver, Canada and Bilbao, Spain.
